Hate, Betrayal, and Trust.Name: Speak with Retainer Ozval
Hate, Betrayal, and Trust.Instructions: Meet Retainer Ozval at the central huts in Lake Nerius, near (201, -97, -7).

Hate, Betrayal, and Trust.Name: Recover the damaged signet ring
Hate, Betrayal, and Trust.Instructions: Loot Ancient Signet Ring of House Everling from Corrupted Kedgespawn in the northwest lake at (2662, 1238, -119). The source suggests a Lake Nerius /pick or private instance if needed.
Terms: Ancient Signet Ring of House Everling

Hate, Betrayal, and Trust.Name: Return the damaged ring
Hate, Betrayal, and Trust.Instructions: Give Ancient Signet Ring of House Everling to Retainer Ozval.
Terms: Ancient Signet Ring of House Everling

Hate, Betrayal, and Trust.Name: Obtain Peerless Sapphire
Hate, Betrayal, and Trust.Instructions: Speak to Merchant Tyslin in Northern Felwithe at (107, -438): "Ozval sent me". Put the sapphire in your bags.

Hate, Betrayal, and Trust.Name: Obtain Exquisite Gem Setter
Hate, Betrayal, and Trust.Instructions: Speak to Rylin Coil in Ak'Anon at (1469, -190): "Ozval sent me". Put the gem setter in your bags.

Hate, Betrayal, and Trust.Name: Deliver the sapphire and gem setter
Hate, Betrayal, and Trust.Instructions: Give Peerless Sapphire and Exquisite Gem Setter to Retainer Ozval.

Hate, Betrayal, and Trust.Name: Obtain Blessing of the Betrayer
Hate, Betrayal, and Trust.Instructions: In the normal, non-instanced Plane of Hate, find High Priestess of Ulkorruuk on the second floor near (-90, 287, 127). Hail and say "swear" without hiding or sneaking; put the blessing in your bags.

Hate, Betrayal, and Trust.Name: Deliver the blessing and enter the castle
Hate, Betrayal, and Trust.Instructions: Give Blessing of the Betrayer to Retainer Ozval, then follow the road north and click the castle gates.

The Tragic Tale of House Everling.Name: Hear Lord Ollix Everling's request
The Tragic Tale of House Everling.Instructions: Inside the castle, hail Lord Ollix Everling near the ruined harpsichord and ask about "dead". His exact coordinates remain undocumented.

The Tragic Tale of House Everling.Name: Collect Harpsichord Black Key
The Tragic Tale of House Everling.Instructions: Pick up Harpsichord Black Key at (-37, 130) in Nektropos Castle. Southwest chessboard, in front of The Game Master. Coordinates describe the ground item, not the nearby NPC.

The Tragic Tale of House Everling.Name: Collect Harpsichord White Key
The Tragic Tale of House Everling.Instructions: Pick up Harpsichord White Key at (710, 105) in Nektropos Castle. Northwest storage area with boxes. Coordinates describe the ground item, not the nearby NPC.

The Tragic Tale of House Everling.Name: Collect Harpsichord String
The Tragic Tale of House Everling.Instructions: Pick up Harpsichord String at (120, -151) in Nektropos Castle. Southeast Tormentor room. Coordinates describe the ground item, not the nearby NPC.

The Tragic Tale of House Everling.Name: Collect Harpsichord Plectrum
The Tragic Tale of House Everling.Instructions: Pick up Harpsichord Plectrum at (-23, -100) in Nektropos Castle. Southeast Priestess room. Coordinates describe the ground item, not the nearby NPC.

The Tragic Tale of House Everling.Name: Combine the Nektropos Library Key
The Tragic Tale of House Everling.Instructions: At the ruined harpsichord in the main lobby, (368, 65), combine the four harpsichord components. This is a quest-object combine, not evidence of a tradeskill recipe.

The Tragic Tale of House Everling.Name: Make contact with Ollix's mother
The Tragic Tale of House Everling.Instructions: Find Lady Sileniu Everling in the northeast second-floor chambers at (552, -132, 17).

The Tragic Tale of House Everling.Name: Hear Lady Everling's plea
The Tragic Tale of House Everling.Instructions: Ask Lady Sileniu Everling about "He", then "swear". This starts The Betrayer.

The Tragic Tale of House Everling.Name: Complete The Betrayer
The Tragic Tale of House Everling.Instructions: Follow The Betrayer's separately documented route through the sisters, Alexa and Lord Rikantus, then say "end" to Plimptos. The nested quest grants Blood's Unity; the parent does not establish a second copy.

The Tragic Tale of House Everling.Name: Confess to Lady Sileniu Everling
The Tragic Tale of House Everling.Instructions: Tell Lady Sileniu Everling "dead", then "confess". Defeat her after she turns hostile.

The Tragic Tale of House Everling.Name: Return to Lord Ollix Everling
The Tragic Tale of House Everling.Instructions: Return to Lord Ollix Everling and say "tragic". The source records completion of the House Everling achievement.

The Betrayer.Name: Accept Lady Everling's task
The Betrayer.Instructions: Speak to Lady Sileniu Everling near (552, -132, 17): "He", then "swear".

The Betrayer.Name: Hear Plimptos' account
The Betrayer.Instructions: Find Plimptos downstairs at (102, -151, 7); say "crimes", then "brought back" for the sword hilt.

The Betrayer.Name: Speak to Alexa's Handmaiden
The Betrayer.Instructions: Hail Alexa's Handmaiden in the southeast second-floor area near (172, -178).

The Betrayer.Name: Defeat the six sisters
The Betrayer.Instructions: Defeat Jenni, Melanie, Crysta, Shelia, Elise and Deirdre Everling. Recorded locations: Jenni (342, -423, 17); Crysta (859, 311, 18); Shelia (352, 428, 17); Elise (-157, 321, 17). Exact Melanie/Deirdre coordinates remain undocumented.

The Betrayer.Name: Return for the Great Room Key
The Betrayer.Instructions: Hail Alexa's Handmaiden again to receive Nektropos Great Room Key.

The Betrayer.Name: Defeat Alexa Everling
The Betrayer.Instructions: Defeat Alexa in the southwest second-floor great room to obtain Nektropos Private Chamber Key. Her exact coordinates remain undocumented.

The Betrayer.Name: Find the basement entrance
The Betrayer.Instructions: Use the secret entrance behind the bookshelf in the Guard Captain's northwest second-floor room. Exact captain coordinates remain undocumented.

The Betrayer.Name: Defeat The Juggernaught
The Betrayer.Instructions: Follow the basement corridor southwest to The Juggernaught at (-331, 310, -112) for Nektropos Basement Key.

The Betrayer.Name: Defeat Lord Rikantus Everling
The Betrayer.Instructions: Defeat Lord Rikantus Everling beside the Juggernaught room at (-382, 181, -112). Wiki combat notes describe golem phases; these are guidance, not a Catalyst damage formula.

The Betrayer.Name: Return to Plimptos
The Betrayer.Instructions: Say "end" to Plimptos. Blood's Unity is the documented quest reward. Then resume the House Everling quest.

Something Fishy.Instructions: Hail Nikko Canti in Lake Nerius and say "not", "haven't seen", "feed", and "help"
